about: FEC.gov campaign finance data (via the public OpenFEC API at api.open.fec.gov/v1). The CLI covers candidate and committee lookups, fundraising and spending totals, itemized receipts and disbursements, outside spending, filings, elections, calendars and advisory opinions.

commands.summary: Autocomplete or search candidates by name and get their FEC candidate IDs

params.name: q
params.description: Candidate name or part of it

params.name: api_key
params.description: api.data.gov API key. DEMO_KEY works but is heavily rate-limited; a free key is available at api.data.gov/signup

commands.summary: Autocomplete or search committees (campaigns, PACs, parties) by name and get their FEC committee IDs

params.name: q
params.description: Committee name or part of it

params.name: api_key
params.description: api.data.gov API key. DEMO_KEY works but is heavily rate-limited; a free key is available at api.data.gov/signup

commands.summary: Rank candidates by money raised, spent, or cash on hand for an election year, optionally filtered by office or state (raising/spending 'by the numbers')

params.name: sort
params.description: Sort key. Prefix with - for descending.

params.description: Totals for the full election period (true) or the two-year cycle only (false)

params.name: api_key
params.description: api.data.gov API key. DEMO_KEY works but is heavily rate-limited; a free key is available at api.data.gov/signup
